instruction: A park fountain: a round tiered basin with visible bowl thickness and a coping rim, a central pedestal supporting a smaller upper bowl, water plane surfaces in the basins, and a small ground apron. Meter scale, weathered stone.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of a park fountain. A park fountain: a round tiered basin with visible bowl thickness and a coping rim, a central pedestal supporting a smaller upper bowl, water plane surfaces in the basins, and a small ground apron. Meter scale, weathered stone. Make it procedural from three.js geometry with realistic proportions, materials and lighting, and orbit controls.
